The burnFrom function allows any user to devalue tokens from any other user, which can be exploited to target a user's assets in a trade, causing a forced liquidation.
The balanceOf function allows the initial distribution of tokens to be arbitrarily set by the owner, which can be exploited to grant unfair advantages to the owner.
